When you’re ready to expand your bar, tap on What To Buy Next to see exactly what you need to get the next time you’re at the liquor store. Vector Bar lets you know which new bottle or bitters will unlock the most new cocktails.

INTELLIGENT COCKTAIL SEARCH
Vector Bar’s cocktail search is unrivaled. In the mood for Bourbon and Honey? Just type it in the search at the top of the Home View and immediately see results for Gold Rush, The Democrat, and a Hot Toddy.  Interested in recreating classics from the Pegu Club or Flatiron Lounge? Just type the bar, city, or mixologist and instantly see results. Vector Bar now supports searching for ingredients you don't like: just type -Mezcal to search for any cocktail without Mezcal, or search for Negroni -Gin to see all of the Negroni variants without Gin.

STEP-BY-STEP
Vector Bar's recipe view is designed for making cocktails, with step-by-step instructions in the precise order you need them. Check off each step to see your progress and keep track of exactly where you are in a recipe, so you'll never accidentally forget a pour again!

LOG AND SHARE
Keep notes and star ratings for each drink you mix so you can learn how to improve your craft and tailor it to suit your tastes for the next round. Add Your Friends in Vector Bar to see what cocktails they are logging and to share your logs. Ratings and Notes are instantly shared in the app between you and your friends.

MODERN MIXOLOGY
Vector Bar has over 400 cocktail recipes, with a focus on modern classics from the top mixologists and bartenders around the world. We are rapidly adding to our cocktail book, with each release bringing new recipes. Please let us know if you’d like us to add one of your favorites, and we’ll get it in the next release!

SCALABLE SPIRITS
Scale up - or down - any cocktail to fit your evening. Having a friend over? Make a double. Hosting a party? Batch your cocktail for 6, 9, or 12. And for those nights when you want to taste a few different recipes, scale down to 1/2, 1/3, or even 1/4, with instant adjustments of every recipe step.

INSTANT SYNC
Create a free account to instantly sync your data across all of your iPhones and iPads.  Log your recipe notes for a cocktail, and it will immediately sync to all of your devices. All cocktail lists, bar ingredients, and recent cocktails are securely stored in the cloud and instantly available when you sign into another device.

GLOBAL COCKTAIL MAP
Another Vector Bar exclusive is our Global Cocktail Map. Tap on Cocktails By Location to see a map of famous places in cocktail history with links to all of the drinks created there. Zoom into New York, New Orleans, London, or Paris to see where the classics were created and where modern mixologists are creating the best new cocktails of today. Interested in a specific cocktail?  Tap on the Map icon at the top of a cocktail and get transported to exactly where it was created. 

SUPPORT
We are building this app for you. Please reach out to team@vectorbar.app and let us know what we can add to make your life as a home bartender easier.
